sn3.17:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ || || Ekam antam nisīdi || || Ekam antam nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Atthi nu kho bhante eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || ||
sn3.17:2.1: Atthi kho mahārāja eko dhammo yo ubho samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || ||
sn3.17:3.1: Katamo pana bhante eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || ||
sn3.17:4.1: Appamādo kho mahārāja eko dhammo ubho atthe samadhigghayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || || Seyyathāpi mahārāja yāni kānici jaṅgamānam pāṇānam padajatāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti || hatthipadaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam mahantena || evam eva kho mahārāja eko dhammo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikam cā ti || || Āyum ārogiyaṃ
sn3.17:5.1: vaṇṇaṃ || saggam uccākulīnataṃ || ratiyo patthayantena || uḷārā aparāparā || ||
sn3.17:6.1: appamādam pasaṃsanti || puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā || appamatto ubho atthe || adhigaṇhāti paṇḍito ||
sn3.17:7.1: diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho || yo c-attho samparāyiko || || atthābhisamayā dhīro || paṇḍito ti pavuccatīti || ||
